findings.is_20pct_realistic: not stable structurally. Strongest structural simplification so far (atomic insert vs full UoW path) still 28.38%. UUIDv7 reduced raw insert time but failed repetition measurement. Typical of B-tree locality/WAL state and low absolute durations.
findings.group_commit_note: Group commit helps real concurrent HTTP/SDK bursts but not the sequential test, where each next call starts only after the previous audit commit is acknowledged; holding one transaction open across already-answered calls would violate terminal synchronous persistence.

options_assessed.a_better_implement: Meaningful only for real concurrent HTTP/SDK load (batch terminal calls into one UoW transaction; each call keeps its own event, waits for shared commit). Does not resolve the unchanged sequential test. UUID/actor-parse/event-construction/hash micro-opts are too small / already disproven as unstable. Index redesign would need measurement against paging/filter requirements.
options_assessed.b_measurement_method: If a relative metric is kept: relative ratio diagnostic only; baseline and audit start from identical DB snapshots per pair; explicit checkpoint before controlled pairs; more pairs in an isolated process; report paired ratios + spread/confidence interval; keep a separate steady-state test incl. natural WAL checkpoints; measure HTTP and SDK with realistic concurrent bursts; do not use an artificially-empty-transaction baseline as the product baseline (only makes the ratio look good).
options_assessed.c_spec_relaxation: Recommended + already user-authorized (spec-3-8 v4 2026-10-09). Remove <20% pass/fail gate; keep logging overhead as diagnostic; hard gates: audit burst <1s, exactly one insert per call (assert 100 inserts for 100 calls), no other SQLite writes, durable commit before reply, persistence verifiable after close/reopen, HTTP and SDK covered separately. Corresponds to memory.md:258.
